doc.class_javadoc:
/** * Utility class used for efficient storage of {@link JsonToken} * sequences, needed for temporary buffering. * Space efficient for different sequence lengths (especially so for smaller * ones; but not significantly less efficient for larger), highly efficient * for linear iteration and appending. Implemented as segmented/chunked * linked list of tokens; only modifications are via appends. *

* Note that before version 2.0, this class was located in the "core" * bundle, not data-binding; but since it was only used by data binding, * was moved here to reduce size of core package */ public

* Note: instances are not synchronized, that is, they are not thread-safe * if there are concurrent appends to the underlying buffer. * * @return Parser that can be used for reading contents stored in this buffer */
